scope: Recomputed saved final holdouts against source history; no retraining. Observed sales are not certified uncensored demand or representative of a business.

operational_validation.reason: No observed inventory movements, immediate fulfillment, stockouts or supplier order/receipt records supplied. No service outcome inferred from forecasts.

notes: Coverage is observation-weighted; series distributions are reported separately.
No independent-sample confidence interval is claimed for correlated series/leads.
Do not tune on these test results and continue calling the same period untouched.
Aggregate forecast metrics may combine different units/scales; inspect per-series results.
